roleTitle: Finance Operations Analyst, Credit Workflow System
jobDescription: The credit workflow system at a commercial bank routes loan applications through underwriting, approval and disbursement. The Finance Operations Analyst owns the disbursement reconciliation control, leads the month-end reconciliation close for the credit book, approves reconciliation adjustments within a delegated limit, and reports control results to the finance controller.
requirements: Owns the disbursement reconciliation control and leads the month-end reconciliation close for the credit book.
Approves reconciliation adjustments within a delegated limit and escalates larger ones to the finance controller.
Maintains the reconciliation procedure and the control evidence pack.
Coordinates the close timetable with treasury and the credit operations team and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions at each month-end.

evidence.text: Led the month-end disbursement reconciliation close for the credit book at a commercial bank for twenty-two months, as the named control owner in the finance control register, running the close timetable and signing the close-out checklist.

Held a delegated approval limit of 25,000 for reconciliation adjustments, approving adjustments within the limit in the reconciliation tool under my own user id and escalating larger ones to the finance controller with a proposed treatment.
Maintained the reconciliation procedure and assembled the control evidence pack each month for internal audit, including the adjustment log, the sign-off record and the break ageing report.

Agreed the close timetable each month with treasury and the credit operations team, recording in the close plan that treasury owned the funding entries and credit operations owned the disbursement queue.
Responsibilities included control ownership, adjustment approvals within limit, procedure maintenance and evidence packs for the disbursement reconciliation over about two years.

Work sample: the control register entry naming the candidate as control owner, one month's signed close-out checklist and the adjustment log showing approvals under the candidate's user id, with the reconciliation tool's record identifiers as a verification trail.
Reference call with the former finance controller: confirmed the candidate was the registered control owner, held the 25,000 delegated limit and led the month-end close; confirmed employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate has a one-month notice period and is available for an on-site control walkthrough.

propositions.text: The candidate maintained the reconciliation procedure and assembled the monthly control evidence pack for internal audit.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the procedure and evidence pack directly.

propositions.text: The candidate agreed the monthly close timetable with treasury and credit operations and recorded who owned which entries.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the timetable coordination and the recorded boundaries.

propositions.text: The candidate led the month-end disbursement reconciliation close as the registered control owner and approved adjustments within a delegated limit of 25,000.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the control register entry, the adjustment log and the reference all state the ownership and the delegated limit.

gold.expectedGap: Hand-over conditions at each month-end are only partly documented in the close-out checklist.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented: control owner and approvals within the 25,000 limit; do not extend it to adjustments above the limit, which went to the finance controller.
followUpTargets: Ask how hand-over conditions were recorded at each month-end.
